title: aap_assets_v1.publish_operator_item_original

owner_lifecycle.allocation: Allocation is independent and FK-free: dataset_id is an opaque scope, so a caller may allocate before its Dataset is published. Publication and item/scene binding validate the business scope in the caller's unit of work. Allocation never claims.
owner_lifecycle.claim: open_operator_storage_operation(uuid) atomically acquires the write permit and claims an allocated creation (status preparing, operation_id, claimed_at); for an already verified creation it issues a distinct creation-bound read permit and leaves the creation untouched. Reply carries operation_id and mode write|read. There is no separate claim capability.
owner_lifecycle.staging: origin=direct persists the caller-reserved staging locator (staging_bucket, staging_key) plus the caller's observed etag/version_id in source; the staging bucket is independently proven from the validated import binding. staging_ref stays NULL, which the staging-ref constraint explicitly allows. A different staging key for the same authority never silently retargets.
owner_lifecycle.mode: A connection-backed datasets binding always forces mode write; only the legacy platform binding may adopt an existing source key.
owner_lifecycle.prepared: Prepared evidence is frozen only when it matches the reserved bucket/object_key and the bounded byte budget.
owner_lifecycle.writing: The writing transition atomically creates the Main storage_usage_mutations intent (producer managed_original_creation, purpose managed_original, kind create, state pending, physical_outcome unknown) with Main's exact idempotency and scope recipes.
owner_lifecycle.verified: Verification requires explicit physical_settled=true and readback equal to the frozen sha256/md5/size and the written receipt etag/version_id; it settles only this creation's write permit and finalizes the accounting intent (confirmed only with a version-pinned current-head match, otherwise unknown).
owner_lifecycle.failure: Failures carry physical_settled and physical_outcome not_written|written|unknown. A proven-drained failure settles only the matching permit and finalizes accounting (delta 0 only for not_written); an unknown drain keeps both the permit and the pending accounting window.
owner_lifecycle.close: close_operator_storage_operation(creation_id, operation_id, physical_settled) settles only a creation-bound read permit; missing/foreign permits and write permits are rejected, and an unsettled close returns operation_unsettled while retaining the permit.
owner_lifecycle.accounting: No compensating trigger exists: the native owner writes and finishes storage_usage_mutations exactly as Main's _change(record_mutation=True)/accounting does. No table or sequence privilege is granted to consumers.

auxiliary.reuse: published owner or verified creation for the same dataset/kind/contract or item
auxiliary.material: owner-issued bucket/object_key/etag/version/storage_ref plus connection destination when bound
auxiliary.binding: item/runtime metadata receipt must match owner key, sha256 and size before the pointer is set

invariants: the creation must be dataset-owned, verified and authoritative for the exact item
the current item locator/size/content hash must equal the caller-observed values before replacement
an existing verified asset with different content is never overwritten
the item locator and managed-original receipt advance together; prior unverified/replaced locators are retired from the receipt while their object is retained
Labeling-owned task rows are not modified; linked tasks continue to resolve through dataset_item_id
